confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors cross-check several aggregated San Antonio sources (Numbeo-based city figures, Square, PriceListo, GOBankingRates), although their dates and methods vary. Beer and cocktail anchors rest on fewer, mixed-quality figures. The wine glass anchor is derived from the beer anchor (about 1.5x) because no reliable per-glass restaurant average was found, so it may be off by a few dollars. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and San Antonio context for July 2026; no accommodation search was run and no live booking pages or listings were checked. FX: the 2026-11-03 value came from third-party reporting attributed to the RBA and was not read directly from the RBA table. The RBA page snapshot in search showed 0.7088 for 2026-03-20, so the FX provenance is unverified and the value should be checked against the official F11.1 series.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are San Antonio-specific where aggregated city data was found. Accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of US mid-sized metro hotel and hostel pricing for July 2026.
